artifact_partitions.rule: UPU evidence is a graph assertion only and has no geometry authority.
Only transformed government land geometry enters the geometry artifact; source identity, licence, digest, region links and derived class remain visible.
Population and historical population source properties are never copied into graph, geometry or UI records.
No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer or land-rights record is published.
